01 Projects
001Current · Spring 2026
Robotics · Mechatronics
Modular Omni-Wheel Mobile Manipulator

Designing and building a fully integrated mobile manipulator for the Spring 2026 Mechatronics Omni-Challenge at Ain Shams University. The robot combines a holonomic omni-wheel base with a modular robotic arm and gripper, operating across two modes: manual wireless teleoperation and fully autonomous pick-and-place using QR code detection for color-based cube sorting. Each module is a standalone plug-and-play subsystem with its own controller, power distribution, and standardized interfaces. Integrates wheel encoder odometry, IMU-based heading stabilization, and a camera vision pipeline.

ROS2Omni-Wheel DriveComputer VisionAutonomous NavPCB DesignIMU FusionC++
002Completed · MDP411s
Structural Analysis · FEA
FEA of Wind Turbine Lattice Tower

Performed full Finite Element Analysis on a 3D wind turbine lattice tower using a custom MATLAB FEA solver built from scratch. Modeled 4 critical loading cases — vertical and horizontal centrifugal forces in ±Z and ±Y directions — computing nodal displacements, support reactions, and member stresses across 250+ truss elements. Identified the critical load case yielding ±93.938 MPa at elements 225/249 and 241/233. Validated via deformed shape visualization and Excel output.

FEAMATLABStructural AnalysisTruss ElementsWind TurbineStress Analysis
